issues: TypeScript compile error in `expo-app/src/screens/ExportScreen.tsx`: `Property 'cacheDirectory' does not exist on type 'typeof import("expo-file-system/build/index")'`. The lazy import `const { default: FileSystem } = await import('expo-file-system');` returns a module whose default export type does not include the static `cacheDirectory` property, causing the TS2339 error and making the static validation step fail. This also prevents the Export screen from working correctly, causing the UI flow test to time out when trying to click the "Export CSV" button.
Same lazy import pattern is used for `expo-sharing`, which may also suffer from type mismatches.
